name: microfocus-movie
description: 微信免费短剧小程序、内容管理后台与权益服务

scripts.build: npm run build -w @microfocus/contracts && npm run build --workspaces --if-present --include-workspace-root=false
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @microfocus/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present --include-workspace-root=false
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @microfocus/contracts && npm run dev -w @microfocus/api
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build -w @microfocus/contracts && npm run dev -w @microfocus/admin
scripts.dev:uniapp: npm run build -w @microfocus/contracts && npm run dev:mp-weixin -w @microfocus/uniapp
